subject: Adjust calculation of Satorra-Bentler scaling factor for multigroup analysis with varying items

messages.author: 25a6c6f4afee9ffa
messages.subject: Adjust calculation of Satorra-Bentler scaling factor for multigroup analysis with varying items
parts:
Dear all,
 
I am running multigroup CFA in Lavaan and (because of nonnormality) want to adjust the model chisquare. However, I do not want to do that with the built-in Satorra-Bentler scaling factor, but with a version of the Satorra-Bentler scaling factor that would only based on parts of the matrices that typically go into its calculation. I wonder whether anyone could suggest a (relatively easy) way to do so in the R/Lavaan environment. Any help would be very much appreciated.
 
Below, I sketch the background of my request.
 
I am trying to follow the procedure suggested by Baumgartner and Steenkamp (1998) for multigroup analysis with varying numbers of observed variables in the different groups. Suppose observed variable A is not measured in the Group 1. Their "trick" then is to impute random values for the missing values that A has in Group 1, while making sure that A has zero mean, unit variance, and zero covariances with all other items, in which case the sample variances and covariances of A can be perfectly reproduced by the CFA/SEM model. As such, the imputation of values does not affect the model chisquare.
 
However, the imputation of values does lead to incorrect goodness of fit measures like CFI, TLI, RMSEA and SRMR, due to the fact that the degrees of freedom and the number of "observed" covariances are artificially increased. Still correct fit measures can easily be calculated from the Lavaan output. However, the imputed values also affect the Satorra-Bentler scaling factor and I am still looking for a (hopefully relatively easy) way to get the correct scaling factor.
 
I have attached some Lavaan output as an example (for simplicity in an analysis with one group only) for the problem I am facing. The file "nlgen.all1.mlm.txt" is from CFA without the observed variables Ethical20, Ethical32, and Ethical19 (and without their underlying factor Ethical), whereas the file "nlgen.all1.mlm.fill.normal.txt" is from CFA with the observed variables Ethical20, Ethical32, and Ethical19 which got imputed values. As you can see, the ML model chisquare stays the same, but CFI, TLI, RMSEA, SRMR, and , worst of all, the Satorra-Bentler scaling factor changed.
 
Kind regards,
Ivo van der Lans

Have a look at the function in lavaan computing the SB scaling factor
(currently named 'testStatisticSatorraBentler', but function names are
changing):

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/blob/master/R/lav_test.R

You could make a local copy of this function, change the name, and
adjust as you see fit.

Yves.
